description:
The memory-first coding agent

Letta Code is a memory-first coding harness, designed for long-lived agents that can learn from experience.
Instead of working in independent sessions, you work with a persisted agent whose memory is portable across models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, Kimi, and more).
What's Changed
- refactor(cli): remove unused dream subcommand by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4092
- fix(reminders): clarify secret injection mechanism by @kianjones9 in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4100
- feat(shared-memory): auto-push committed changes by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4103
- feat(skills): let agents submit user feedback by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4104
- fix(memory): validate shared memory frontmatter by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4102
- fix(reflection): pause retries for invalid models by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4101
- fix(headless): hide best-effort tool bootstrap failures by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4088
- feat(memory): enforce configurable memory limits by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4105
- docs: add code review signals, extension/mod system, and more to AGENTS.md by @carenthomas in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4107
- fix: upgrade pi-ai to 0.84.4 and remove temporary OpenRouter thinkingLevelMap patch by @carenthomas in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4108
- chore: bump version to 0.31.6 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4109
